_readme: Oracle for the cross-repo contract task (test 3). Declared BEFORE any LAIN query — the runner asserts against this file, never against what the tools happened to answer. Evidence classes follow the product's own taxonomy (tests/fixtures/contracts/ground_truth.yaml: impact.class Verified | NeedsInvestigation, plus 'missing' for information the graph cannot have). Presenting inferred or absent evidence as verified is the serious failure; not finding something is not.

fixture.base: scripts/contracts-fixture.sh — deterministic 4-repo fixture: orders (Rust/axum + openapi.yaml), billing (Python/FastAPI+httpx), reports (TS/Express), platform (Python monorepo: shipping + inventory)
fixture.scenario_anchor: tests/fixtures/contracts/ground_truth.yaml scenario 11 (FieldRenamed customer_id -> customerId, BreakingIfRead, impact Verified, affected billing Verified)
fixture.test_note: orders' tests check the contract artifact (handler + openapi.yaml) — the fixture is source-only and is never compiled; billing's tests are behavioral (stdlib, framework stubbed). Both are the oracle: red before the change, green after. Nobody may edit tests/.

change.description: orders renames the response field customer_id to customerId (same type) on its HTTP responses; billing's reads must follow. Endpoint paths and public function names unchanged; tests/ untouched. Committing is allowed if the tool's update path requires it.

provider.scope: response schemas only (Order); the request model CreateOrder keeps customer_id

consumer.via: fetch_order -> http:GET /api/orders/{} (static Binds + ReadsField, provenance static confidence 1.0)

affected.why: static Binds + ReadsField: reads customer_id from http:GET /api/orders/{} (provenance static, confidence 1.0)

false_positive_traps.why: calls https://api.stripe.com — external host, never a consumer of orders and never unresolved
calls http:GET /api/orders/me but reads no fields (read_fields: []) — the renamed field is not read here
consumes billing's http:GET /invoices/{} — a different hop; orders' field rename is not in its contract
same-repo hop shipping -> inventory inside platform; unrelated to orders' response fields

missing_information.what: coverage is configured_only — impact analysis may not claim exhaustiveness
api.stripe.com is external — visible as external, never as unresolved

post_edit.stale_would_look_like: the old field still in the contract, or no diff at all — a FAIL, not 'no risk'

classes.verified: the federation proves it (Binds/ReadsField static, or diff impact Verified)
classes.needs-investigation: the tool flags it but cannot prove it (impact NeedsInvestigation, reasons like unresolved_candidates/no_schema)
classes.missing: the information is not in the graph at all (e.g. coverage.complete=false) — say so instead of claiming 'no impact'
